name: Saudi Cable Company
summary: Saudi Cable Company (SCC), a publicly listed entity, operates manufacturing facilities across Saudi Arabia, Bahrain, and Turkey. The company and its subsidiaries are deeply involved in the production, distribution, installation, testing, commissioning, and maintenance of a wide array of electrical infrastructure components. This extensive product range includes power cables of extra high, medium, and low voltage, building wires, telecommunication cables, instrumentation and specialized control cables, as well as electrical substations, switchgear, cable accessories, and transformers. Furthermore, the SCC Group maintains a robust network of warehouses to facilitate the supply of all types of cables and related electrical products. SCC also provides comprehensive, end-to-end electrical system solutions, encompassing supply, installation, testing, commissioning, and ongoing maintenance, all supported by advanced digital and information technology systems.
